name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
target_group: Eligible BPL persons with severe disability under NSAP criteria
eligibility: Current NSAP disability and age conditions must be met.
benefits: Central pension assistance of ₹300/month for eligible beneficiaries aged 18–79 and ₹500/month for age 80+, plus applicable state contribution.
application_process: Apply through the state/UT authority implementing NSAP.
source: Ministry of Rural Development / Government of India
